title: QAEvidence
description: Immutable evidence and gate results collected by QA orchestration workers. Independent of agent opinion; agents may produce artifacts, workers validate them.

evidenceId.description: Unique identifier for this evidence record

gateId.description: QA gate that collected or required this evidence (e.g., 'static-analysis')

workItemId.description: Work item this evidence belongs to

evidenceType.description: Evidence kind required by the QAContract (e.g., 'coverage-report', 'scan-results')

artifactRef.description: Reference to the artifact/path the evidence was derived from

content.description: Structured evidence content (tool output, metrics, reports)

collectedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evidence was collected

validatorId.description: Worker or validator that collected this evidence

QAWaiver.description: Human waiver attached to a gate that failed but was accepted

evidence.description: List of QA evidence records for this gate

QAGateResult.description: Per-gate evaluation result consumed by the workflow engine
